cbcProfiles.query:
select r.master_key as order_key,r.current_revision,panel.master_key as panel_key,test.master_key as test_key,spec.master_key as specimen_key,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('test_key',tr.master_key,'required',i.required,'sort',i.sort_order,'group',i.display_group) order by i.sort_order) from master.lab_panel_items i join master.master_records tr on tr.id=i.lab_test_id where i.lab_panel_id=p.lab_panel_id) as panel_members
from master.lab_order_profiles p join master.master_records r on r.id=p.order_record_id
left join master.master_records panel on panel.id=p.lab_panel_id left join master.master_records test on test.id=p.lab_test_id left join master.master_records spec on spec.id=p.specimen_type_id
where r.master_key in ('cm.order.lab.panel.cbc-basic','cm.order.lab.test.cbc-wbc','cm.order.lab.test.cbc-hct','cm.order.lab.test.cbc-plt','cm.order.synthetic.lab-08','cm.order.synthetic.lab-09') order by 1

update public.lab_result_entry_rows set result_value=case when jsonb_typeof(v_row->'value')='null' then null else v_row->>'value' end,note=case when jsonb_typeof(v_row->'note')='null' then null else v_row->>'note' end,judgment='not_judged',updated_at=now() where workspace_id=p_workspace_id and lab_result_entry_id=v_entry.id and row_id=v_row->>'rowId';
